## Overview

- Generate the Awesome Copilot plugin preview image from the Canvas Extension screenshot instead of
  the MarkdStage Desktop Store screenshot, so the marketplace visual matches the submitted canvas
  plugin.
- Keep the shared product version aligned at 4.2.3 across the Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI,
  and Desktop.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. Update version-pinned installation links to `v4.2.3`.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.3`. |
| Awesome Copilot plugin | No action is required; only the bundled preview image changed. |
